evidence.note: Independently checked the current full published power-series proof and the uniqueness corollary. Step 7.1 is false: m=1, a=0, M=r=c_1=1, all other c_n=0, beta=0, theta=1/2 gives 1≤1/2. Missing valid prerequisite is the reindexed derivative-coefficient estimate and its iterated coefficient identity, used by cor-uniqueness-of-multivariable-power-series-coefficients and lemma 2.2. Attempted closure: replacing theta^(|beta|+1) by theta^|beta| yields a correct bound, with (beta_k+1)theta^|beta|≤(1-theta)^(-2); finite nested shrinkings then permit iteration on every interior point. Lebl §1.2 Theorem 1.2.1 and Proposition 1.2.2 support the correct result; this does not repair the current published/imported bytes.
